afterDefects: Flat, uniform brown ground plane with a repetitive tiled cobble texture. The tiny cone scatter at the horizon reads as placeholder art. The sky is somewhat grey and dull. It does have warmer ember particles, a textured tee and better contrast.
Ember particles are scattered over the player. The far terrain has repetitive cobble tiling, and the warm brown palette is a bit muddy.
Cobblestone ground texture repeats in a visible tile pattern; the white aim line looks flat and floats over the ground; the many small cone props look sparse and generic; the sky is a little hazy.
The grass is fairly saturated and somewhat tiled, and the fairway is flat. Otherwise it is clear and well lit, with a textured lawn, a golfer shadow, a crisp tree line and a good sky.
Grass is a fairly saturated, uniform green, and the tee-box rim is flat. Otherwise the frame is crisp with good contrast and grounded shadows.
The green is a bit oversaturated and uniform; grass tiling is slightly visible; otherwise clear, with a good shadow and sky.
Very saturated, slightly game-y green grass with visible tiling. The trees are simple stacked spheres. Otherwise the autumn colours are vivid, there are shadows and readability is good.
A small orange tree blob seems to float near the left tree group. The grass tiling is slightly visible.
Grass tiling is slightly visible; a small orange foliage blob floats between the trees; the trees are simple primitives.
The sky is pure black, and the crater texture tiles repetitively. Otherwise the regolith texture is convincing, and the strong long shadows and blue rim light read well.
The sky is completely black with no stars, which is stark. The long shadows dominate the foreground.
The top half of the frame is black sky; the crater texture tiles noticeably; otherwise readable, with strong shadows and good material detail.
The teal grass is a bit uniform, and the 'neon' theme is weak. Otherwise the night sky has stars, there is textured turf with shadows and the golfer reads well.
The dusty particles and stars are a little noisy. Otherwise it has good night mood, textured grass and a grounded shadow.
The teal ground is fairly uniform; some bright particle dots look like noise; the trees are simple primitives.
The grass is somewhat dark and tiled, and the shadow band across the tee is slightly odd. Otherwise it is rich and textured, with a nice cloudy sky, clear depth and a visible bunker.
The grass is slightly dark and saturated, and a long shadow band crosses the tee. Otherwise it is crisp, with clouds and good depth.
A dark shadow band runs across the tee; the grass is slightly dark and tiled; minor detail is lost in the distance.
